title: helm: improve private values schema + init hooks for backup/restore and upgrade rollback
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: automated private installs can fail during upgrades when init jobs (postgres backup/restore, secrets migration) are not idempotent or when values schema lacks explicit fields used by the installer. This PR tightens values.schema.json, improves templating for init hooks to be safe for retry/rollback, and introduces explicit upgrade/rollback labels and annotations so the operator can detect in-progress migrations. Changes include: schema updates for backup.enabled/restore.enabled/kms.keyId; templating improvements for init job backoff/restartPolicy and preflight checks; a new helm test that validates rollback path by simulating a failed post-upgrade job; and docs + chart notes for operator behavior on rollback. The description below lists commits, changed files, and the review thread.
commits: validate(values): add strict schema for backup/restore and kms fields
feat(init): make postgres backup/restore jobs idempotent and add preflight checks
test(helm): add rollback simulation helm test
docs: document upgrade/rollback behavior and operator hints
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Can you add a short-circuit path if backups are disabled? Right now the init job template still renders and will create a noop job during dry-run.
Asha Patel: Good catch — added conditional rendering and a unit test for the template to ensure nothing is created when backup.enabled=false
Riley Chen: The preflight now checks for existing PV claims before attempting restore which is good. Please ensure the backoffLimit is low so operator can detect failure quickly during upgrades.
Asha Patel: Set backoffLimit=2 and added explicit podAntiAffinity so upgrade noise doesn't cause collisions. Also documented the operator's expected retry window in the upgrade-rollback doc.
Marisol Ortega: CI flaked on helm lint; looks like a templating edge case for older helm versions. Recommend adding a conditional that guards on .Capabilities.APIVersions.Has for batch/v1jobs.
Asha Patel: Added the APIVersions guard and reran CI. All checks passed. Marking ready to merge.
release_notes: Helm chart: values.schema.json tightened for backup/restore/kms; init jobs (postgres backup/restore) made idempotent with preflight checks and low backoffLimit; added helm test to simulate rollback; documented upgrade/rollback behavior for private installs; no breaking changes for default configs.
